agent_priors_used: Path dependence and local optima dominate long-horizon agent exploration: early salience compounds planning errors, making verbatim trajectory replay harmful without adaptation (MemHarness reconstruction prior) - distinguishes from SPIDER evidence which has not demonstrated reconstruction benefit.

Tunneling indicator: >10 consecutive exps on one claim with vacuous/degenerate controls (deterministic fingerprint, bimodal 0.35/0.65 below threshold, Laplace smoothing bias) signals sharply diminishing marginal information gain - used to weight PARK vs CONTINUE.

LLM agents benefit from memory only with applicability guards and verification/repair boundaries; false accepts and staleness dominate economics, so product economics must measure false_accept, UNKNOWN abstention and repair cost amortized - not token savings alone (SPIDER has shown 5.42% analytical savings only).

Effective dynamics claims require identifiability and history-conditioned baselines; without state/action history conditioning PMI/TV collapses to destination predictability or tautological action->observation mapping - explains repeated leakage (href==url 78-92%) and guides cross-site holdout design.
